searches.answer: The sources mention several new data science tools and frameworks. DeepLearning4j is an open-source Java-based deep-learning framework for JVM, developed by Eclipse, which can speed up training by leveraging multi-CPUs. TensorFlow, developed by Google, is an open-source end-to-end Python-based ML tool with extensive libraries for deep learning neural networks. Keras, a Python library, runs on top of TensorFlow to make deep learning more accessible. Scikit-learn, PyTorch, and Hugging Face are also highlighted for their roles in classical and advanced AI development. Apache Spark and MLflow are noted for handling distributed data and model observability. The sources also emphasize the importance of Python and SQL as foundational tools for data science.
